description: The main goal of ድንቅነሽ team is to create a community of scientists that are interested in strengthening space science sector in developing countries such as Ethiopia. In the upcoming NASA space app challenge hosted in Addis Ababa,  we are taking on the challenge 'Abandoned but not forgotten: Space Equipment on Mars and the Moon with the help of my teammates. I'm looking for teammates with skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or video editing.
